name: Owenodon
sum: An iguanodontian known from a partial lower jaw from the Early Cretaceous Purbeck Limestone of Dorset, England.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: A partial lower jaw from the Lulworth Formation, Purbeck Limestone Group, found by A. J. Hogg and described by Owen in 1874 as Iguanodon hoggii.
material: Possibly material from Romania and Spain; Galton removed other Purbeck fossils from it in 2009.
biology: Not described in the sources consulted.
author: Galton 2009

sources.text: Galton, P.M. 2009. Notes on Neocomian (Late Cretaceous) ornithopod dinosaurs from England – ''Hypsilophodon'', ''Valdosaurus'', "Camptosaurus", "Iguanodon" – and referred specimens from Romania and elsewhere. Revue de Paléobiologie 28(1): 211–273.
